summary: Iter 220ci - Engineer Equipment Tab fully tested. Backend: 43/43 pytest tests pass. Frontend: All pages, forms, navigation, and validation verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 220ci adds the Engineer Equipment Tab. Key components: (1) Backend endpoints at /api/svc/engineer/equipment (GET list, POST create) and /api/svc/engineer/equipment/picklists (GET canonical dropdown values), (2) Frontend list page at /svc/engineer/equipment with data-testid='engineer-equipment-page', (3) Frontend form page at /svc/engineer/equipment/new with data-testid='engineer-equipment-form-page', (4) Workspace sidebar nav button data-testid='ws-nav-equipment', (5) Engineer Home quick action data-testid='qa-equipment', (6) WorkVisitMachinesCard 'New asset' link data-testid='machines-new-asset-link'. All mandatory fields (name, equipment_type, manufacturer, model, location) are validated server-side with strict picklists. Multi-site orgs require site_id. Equipment created via engineer_app flows into the platform-wide equipment collection.
